name: What should I consider when choosing flooring for a historic or period home?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing flooring for a historic or period home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing flooring for a historic or period home, consider maintaining architectural integrity and authenticity. Hardwood, especially species common to the home's era, is often preferred. Reclaimed wood or materials that mimic historical styles can also be excellent choices. Pay attention to finish and plank width to ensure it complements the home's original character. While modern materials like LVP offer practicality, ensure they don't detract from the historical aesthetic. Durability and ease of maintenance suitable for your lifestyle are also important.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider maintaining architectural authenticity, often favoring period-appropriate hardwood or materials that mimic historical styles. Balance aesthetic integrity with durability and maintenance needs.
